description: Configurable Base32 SIMD/SWAR byte codecs, strict original-byte errors, immutable incremental states, checked caller buffers and explicit stream continuations. Full stdlib goal remains open.
status: Final source integrated: 14 Rust checks pass, pre-padding Native 12 checks plus 100 focused final padding goldens on both frozen frontends; benchmarks reviewed

padding_only_followup.scope: standard/hex padded encode/decode; only input-remainder padding calculation changed after full harness

implementation_notes: Fixed standard/hex quanta retain original LLVM SIMD kernels; custom lookup uses exact private byte gathers with packed SWAR validation/compaction.

Custom inverse tables use zero as missing and index+1 as present, eliminating per-entry sentinel initialization. Subtracting packed ones produces an invalid lane at the first missing value; valid lanes cannot borrow.
A direct private scalar-field loop constructs persistent decoder state only when returning, avoiding a state allocation per full quantum.
Stream surplus retains one private buffer and a cursor, copying only returned output slices.
Legacy fixed-text scalar fringes use bounded U64 bit arithmetic instead of dynamic Nat powers/division; scalar collection and final byte materialization use bounded-stack loops.
Legacy exact padding checks inspect only the bounded required suffix rather than taking an unbounded list length.
Fixed-text encoding derives padding in constant time from input length modulo 5 instead of scanning ASCII output as Unicode.
deliberate_semantic_policies: Cinch String conversion is optional for arbitrary binary alphabets; byte APIs preserve all data.
Byte decoder offsets count original bytes including CR/LF, rather than positions after stripping newlines.
Raw final lengths 1/3/6 are rejected and data after a padded final quantum is rejected, even where the pinned reference accepts an odd tail or ignores a suffix.
Decoder prefix/append operations preserve completed quanta and errors; atomic convenience returns only an error.
Finite destination decoding checks the actual completed output before mutation, allowing exact padded-result capacity and safe aliasing.

capability_mapping.Encoding/NewEncoding: Opaque Base32Encoding; checked32-byte copied alphabet and immutable inverse lookup, with Base32ConfigError
capability_mapping.StdPadding/NoPadding (typed and ideal co: Some61 from the standard padding getter; None selects unpadded output
capability_mapping.WithPadding: base32-with-padding returns a checked persistent configuration
capability_mapping.Encode/EncodeToString/AppendEncode: Fresh byte output, optional UTF-8 text, copied-prefix append and atomic checked destination writes
capability_mapping.Decode/DecodeString/AppendDecode: Atomic byte convenience plus text/prefix/append/destination operations retaining completed output and precise errors
capability_mapping.CorruptInputError/Error: Base32InputError, original-byte offset and module-owned diagnostic
capability_mapping.NewEncoder/Write/Close: Inspectable Base32Writer with accepted input counts, explicit finish and advanced sink on failures
capability_mapping.NewDecoder/Read: Bounded source reader with private surplus cursor, inert zero reads and delayed sticky failure
